reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is identical to the original with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

Cited text supports the conclusion: p0084 obliges Sparkling (our party) only to pay fees set out in the Fee Schedule, p0065 makes maintenance a renewable one-year term rather than a multi-year committed spend, and p0118 gives us an unconditional 90-day termination right — no take-or-pay, shortfall or volume commitment on Customer.
Rationale correctly treats the Section 3 licence-scope restrictions as ordinary scope limits rather than volume commitments, and notes them only for completeness.
No actionable proposal is required; the finding is properly retained as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
